featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Bajpai
featured_reviews.review_text:
⚠️ Highly Disappointing Experience - Beware

I had a very bad experience with Paresh Kanshiyal and his team.

I got the filters changed for my Aquaguard Ritz RO + UV in Aug’25, and within just 6 months, the water quality became extremely poor, with abnormally low TDS levels. This was surprising since our society water usually stays around 70–80 PPM.

When I contacted them for a check, instead of diagnosing the issue, their team casually said the filters must already be खराब and need replacement again. This felt completely unreasonable within such a short time.

Out of frustration, I called the official Aquaguard service team. On inspection, they clearly identified that the filters installed were fake:

QR code was not scanning
QR was pasted, not printed
Overall build quality was not genuine

❗ Please be careful and avoid such service providers. Always go with authorized service to ensure genuine parts or check the products beforehand.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Sir sorry for the inconvenience. But we have provided genuine product.
